items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had a manager named Maceo Birch, he travelled with the band

ctx.x: Who travelled with the band other than the band members?
We had a manager named Maceo Birch, he travelled with the band, and Billie Holiday travelled with the band for a while when she first joined the band. Then, Jimmy Rushing he travelled with the band.
Did you have any band boys to help out?
